title: The left blamed Trump and the right for Charlie Kirk's murder.
text:
ARGENTINA
The left blamed Trump and the right for Charlie Kirk's murder.
In an absolutely hypocritical and despicable attitude, several figures from the left and the Democratic Party blamed the U.S. president for Kirk's death
After the murder of conservative activist Charlie Kirk, which took place during a public event at Utah Valley University, various Democratic leaders and left-wing commentators were quick to hypocritically point to the political environment surrounding PresidentDonald Trumpas indirectly responsible for the crime.
In a shameful attitude criticized by American citizens and conservative sectors, members of the left quickly linked the murder to the political climate promoted by the president, omitting any mention of recent attacks against conservative figures, including Trump himself.
The nefarious Democratic governor of Illinois, JB Pritzker, was one of the first to speak publicly after the attack. While he mentioned the general escalation of political violence in the United States, he explicitly alluded to Trump as a source of that tension.
“I believe there are people who are fomenting this violence in the country, and I believe the president's rhetoric often does so,” Pritzker stated to the press, indirectly linking Trump to the crime, even though the attack targeted one of his main allies.
Curiously, Pritzker omitted any mention of the attacks against Trump, such as the assassination attempt in July 2024 in Butler, Pennsylvania, where a father died, or the foiled incident at a golf course in Florida. His silence on the matter was interpreted as a selective political essentialization of violence.
Even more controversial were the comments from MSNBC analyst Matthew Dowd, who directly blamed Kirk's rhetoric for his own death. “You can't keep having these horrible thoughts, saying these horrible words, and then not expect horrible actions to happen,” he said live, even before the activist's death was officially confirmed.
Dowd, who was the Democratic candidate for lieutenant governor of Texas and author of the book Revelations on the River, also suggested that the murder could have been a celebratory shot by a supporter, insinuating that gun culture and the conservative environment could be behind the attack.
Later, MSNBC was forced to issue a public apology describing his statements as “inappropriate, insensitive, and unacceptable.” Dowd also apologized on his BlueSky account, assuring that he did not intend to blame Kirk directly, but his words had already caused strong backlash on social media.
The conservative account Libs of TikTok shared a video compiling posts from left-wing figures and users openly celebrating Charlie Kirk's death, sparking outrage among followers of the conservative movement.
Kirk, 31 years old, was murdered by a deranged leftist, with a shot from 200 yards while speaking at an outdoor event. He was the father of two children and founder of Turning Point USA, a key organization in the expansion of youth conservative activism in the United States.
➡️ Argentina
